turns.question: I'd love to hear about your coffee routine — so think back to a recent time, maybe in the last week or two, when you made a change or tried something different with how you get or make your coffee. What was going on that made you decide to do things differently that day?
turns.response: Honestly, I'm not sure that's really happened recently. I kind of just make coffee the same way most mornings — brew it at home, grab it, go to work. Last week was pretty normal. Maybe I picked up a different brand at the grocery store once but that wasn't really a conscious thing, just what looked decent.

turns.question: When you picked up that different brand at the grocery store, what made you go with it instead of your usual one?
turns.response: Honestly it was probably just on sale that week. I don't really have a strong preference between brands, they're all pretty similar to me. Plus the packaging caught my eye I guess, looked kind of nice sitting there.
